description_en: Adds a data source under the bound multi-cloud account
description_zh: 在该绑定的多云账号下添加数据源
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem add-data-source --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDataSource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud account
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:
obs: Huawei Cloud OBS.
wafApi: Tencent Cloud WAF download API. 
ckafka: Tencent Cloud CKafka
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型。取值：
obs：华为云obs。
wafApi：腾讯云waf下载api。 
ckafka： 腾讯云ckafka
parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source
parameters.name: data_source_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The remark of the data source
parameters.name: data_source_instance_remark

parameters.help_en: The parameters of the data source. The value is a JSON array
parameters.name: data_source_instance_params

parameters.help_en: The code of the multi-cloud provider
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is located. You must select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Assets are located in the Chinese mainland and Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Assets are located outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

Count.description_en: The number of data sources added. A value of 1 indicates success, and a value less than or equal to 0 indicates failure
Count.description_zh: 添加数据源的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败
Count.title_zh: 添加数据源的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败。

DataSourceInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the data source. The ID is generated by Threat Analysis by calculating the MD5 hash of specific parameters
DataSourceInstanceId.description_zh: 数据源ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成
DataSourceInstanceId.title_zh: 数据源ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成。
